introHtml: Dri Duck badge ID holders combine the rugged durability of a trusted outdoor brand with practical workplace functionality. Whether you need to keep IDs accessible for construction crews or trade show staff, these holders resist wear from daily use and harsh conditions. With options for custom imprinting, you can add your logo or text to create branded gear that stands out. Choose from styles that accommodate standard ID cards or include additional features like badge reels or lanyard attachments.
